what_it_measures: A protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen around the body
if_low: Can be linked to tiredness or low iron or other causes
if_high: Can be linked to dehydration or living at high altitude or other causes

what_it_measures: White blood cells that help the body fight infection
if_low: Can mean the body has fewer infection fighters than usual
if_high: Often rises when the body is fighting an infection or inflammation

what_it_measures: Red blood cells that carry oxygen to every part of the body
if_low: Often goes along with low hemoglobin and can be linked to low iron or other causes
if_high: Can be linked to dehydration or living at high altitude or other causes

what_it_measures: Tiny cells that help your blood clot after an injury
if_low: Can lead to easier bruising or bleeding
if_high: Can be linked to inflammation or other causes

what_it_measures: The sugar level in your blood after not eating for at least 8 hours
if_high: Repeated high values can be a sign to check for diabetes

what_it_measures: The sugar level in your blood at any time of day regardless of when you last ate
if_high: Repeated high values can be a sign to check for diabetes

what_it_measures: The total amount of fats in your blood
if_low: Usually not a concern by itself
if_high: High levels can raise the long-term risk of heart problems
